label: Safe refactor
description: Behavior-preserving change with characterization and equivalence evidence.

assignments.lead: Implementation lead — characterize current behavior, refactor in focused steps, prove equivalence, run gates, and commit.
assignments.reviewer: Reviewer — inspect behavioral equivalence, hidden coupling, and scope independently. Do not edit production code.
assignments.verifier: Verifier — run characterization, regression, and mutation checks independently. Limit edits to tests or fixtures.

required_evidence: Repository-defined test, lint, and format gates
